device.name: BESSY II vacuum sensor (bact2, read only)

facts.text: The module imports Component, Device and EpicsSignalRO from ophyd
pressure is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on the PV suffix :rdPress
quality is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on the PV suffix :stMeasQuality
VacuumSensor declares only pressure and quality Components and inherits from the imported ophyd Device; it defines no stop method
The VSR straight example constructs VacuumSensor('VMC3VS2R', name='vsr_straight')
The VSR straight example plots the pressure reading of the vacuum sensor
The package description says it provides ophyd device drivers for BESSY II

measures.description: Fresh read of the raw pressure PV suffix :rdPress (the IOC's engineering unit; no line of the clone states it)
measures.name: pressure

measures.description: Fresh read of the measurement-quality PV suffix :stMeasQuality (the source states no meaning or unit beyond the PV suffix)
measures.name: quality

measures.description: Read the raw pressure PV suffix :rdPress fresh (EpicsSignalRO get, use_monitor=False); no input, no effect
measures.name: read_pressure

safe_state.description: unchanged: the sensor only reads PVs; the e-stop latches the endpoint and calls the inherited ophyd Device.stop, which the clone does not define and this package does not claim changes the device
